scientific_integrity: Exact-arithmetic theorem for three independent real unit Kaczmarz rows; full analytical proof and self-contained rational checker. No outside mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean one-sweep worst-case error, no relaxation, exact projections, exactly three rows in R^3; excludes multi-sweep and floating-point assertions. Finite tests do not establish a universal theorem. Older specialized three-projection literature may contain an equivalent result.
title: The optimal one-sweep order for three Kaczmarz equations
